articles.summary: The Buckle, Inc. (NYSE: BKE) announced that Angie J. Klein has tendered her resignation from the Company’s Board of Directors, effective August 30, 2026, due to obligations related to her new professional role. Ms. Klein has served as a Director for the Company since December 2019, providing valuable insight to the Company for nearly seven years. Daniel J. Hirschfeld, Chairman of the Board, said, “We thank Angie for her contributions and insights during her dedicated service as a valued member of our Board.” Ms. Klein stated, “I am grateful to have had the opportunity to serve on Buckle’s Board of Directors, providing oversight to new areas of corporate social responsibility in addition to influencing and supporting the Company’s ongoing nominating and governance efforts. I am proud of the work we have accomplished together and wish the entire Buckle team the best in the years ahead.” About Buckle Buckle is a specialty retailer focused on delivering exceptional service and style

articles.summary: Our August 6, 2026 press release reported that comparable store sales, for stores open at least one full year, for the four-week period ended August 1, 2026, increased 1.6 percent in comparison to the prior year four-week period ended August 2, 2025. Total net sales for the four-week fiscal month increased 4.1 percent to $115.4 million compared to net sales of $110.8 million in the prior year four-week fiscal month ended August 2, 2025. On the mens side of the business, total sales for the four-week fiscal period ended August 1, 2026 decreased 1.5 percent in comparison to the prior year four-week period ended August 2, 2025. The mens business represented approximately 47.0 percent of total sales for the month, versus approximately 49.5 percent for the same period in the prior year. Net sales for the 4-week fiscal month ended August 1, 2026 increased 4.1 percent to $115.4 million from net sales of $110.8 million for the prior year 4-week fiscal month ended August 2, 2025. Comparable store net sales for the 13-week second quarter ended August 1, 2026 increased 2.1 percent from comparable store net sales for the 13-week period ended August 2, 2025.
